title: Simple AI SDK chat
summary: A focused conversation with streaming replies and message controls.
description: Start with a complete chat interface, then connect the AI SDK transport to your model provider. The preview runs locally with scripted responses so you can explore the UI without a key.
useCase: A standalone chat in a React app

title: Collaborative block editor
summary: Write alongside an assistant in the same editable document.
description: A Lexical document and an assistant share one workspace. Edit blocks by hand, then ask the assistant to add or revise content. The local preview uses scripted editing actions; the source keeps the editor separate from the conversation runtime.

title: Website corner assistant
summary: An assistant that answers questions about the page you are reading.
description: A compact launcher opens a chat beside a sample article. Suggested questions and replies use the article content, keeping the conversation grounded in the visible page. The preview uses local, scripted answers.

title: Data exploration assistant
summary: Ask questions, change filters, and inspect a sample dataset.
description: A chart, a table, and an assistant work from the same checked-in sample dataset. Supported questions calculate answers from the data and update the view. The local preview uses deterministic query matching rather than a live model.

title: Website-use agent
